
## Source

*Buffalo Courier Express*, March 1, 1853, Page 2. via Newspapers.com (https://www.newspapers.com/article/buffalo-courier-express-marriage-of-chur/167262996/ : accessed March 5, 2025), clip page for Marriage of CHURCH / WINSLOW by user neel_smith_home

## Transcription

 On the 28th ult., at the First Presbyterian Church, by the Rev. Dr. Chester, Mr. CHARLES D. CHURCH, to Miss SUSAN D. WINSLOW, all of this city.
